title: Depot on your phone
intro: Depot works in the browser on your phone. There is nothing to install.

sections.heading: Open Depot on your phone
steps: Open the browser on your phone and go to the Depot address.
Sign in the same way you do on your computer.
Tap the menu button at the top left to see **Files**, **Favorites** and **My links**.
Tap a file to preview it. Tap **Download** to save it to your phone.
bullets: Pictures, PDFs and videos open right in the browser.
You can share a file from your phone the same way as on a computer.
sections.tip: Add Depot to your home screen from the browser's share menu. It then opens like an app.
